kultivator.screen.help.kehancuran.title: Mode Kehancuran (OFF by default)
kultivator.screen.help.kehancuran: The ONLY part of Kultivator that breaks real blocks, and only behind three locks that must all be open: (1) the server allows it (config modeKehancuran, or an operator's /kultivasi kehancuran izin on), (2) you swear the Sumpah Kehancuran, (3) you release one disciple's red seal on its Jalan tab. Only a disciple past calamity 4 has a Jurus Pemusnah, and only its ordered cast changes blocks; automatic casts never do. Every order is aimed, previewed, confirmed in chat and announced to the whole dimension with a red-sky countdown you can cancel. Never touched: anything within 64 blocks of a Sect Hall, 24 of any player, spawn, villages, formations, chests and every block with contents, portals, bedrock, fluids. No drops by default; for 10 minutes a cast can be restored (Red Seal tablet or /kultivasi kehancuran pulihkan). Closing any lock stops everything at once.
